label: Bible Study
prompt: With all lowliness and meekness, with _____, forbearing one another in love;
verse: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
note: Four virtues for keeping church family together — longsuffering is patience that goes the distance.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He maketh me to lie down in green _____: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verse: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
note: Green pastures and still waters — the Shepherd picks the spot where the sheep can finally lie down.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Yet Michael the _____, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verse: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
note: Even Michael the archangel wouldn't trade insults with the devil — he just said, 'The Lord rebuke thee.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: O death, where is thy _____? O grave, where is thy victory?
verse: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
note: Paul taunts death itself, borrowing Hosea 13:14 — a resurrection victory lap.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He, that being often reproved _____ his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verse: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
note: Reproved often but still 'hardeneth his neck' — he 'shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.' Warnings run out.
